ns2:course.label: Senior Research Project
ns2:course.description: (ECE 298) Individual research project under the guidance of a faculty member: for example, mathematical analysis, laboratory experiments, computer simulations, software development, circuit design, or device fabrication. Preparation of a written research proposal, which includes preliminary results. 2 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: Senior standing; RHET 105; consent of instructor.
